long_description:
Halloween puppy yoga at Boston Modern Studio in Canton: gentle all-levels movement, rescue puppies, cuddles, costumes and a good cause.

About this Event

Halloween puppy yoga is coming to Boston Modern.

Join Kitten Paws and Downward Dogs at Boston Modern Studio in Canton for a gentle, all-levels yoga class with adoptable rescue puppies making the rounds on the mats. Flow, laugh, get climbed on, and take as many puppy breaks as you need. Halloween colors and costumes are welcome for guests, but never required.

The puppies are the point. Every puppy in the room will come from a rescue or shelter and will be looking for a home. Our rescue partner will bring the puppies, their pen and their volunteers, so you can meet, cuddle and start an adoption conversation on the spot.

Where the money goes. This event will benefit a local Boston-area rescue. We will announce the participating rescue here once it is confirmed, and the net proceeds will go directly to that rescue.

THE DAY
• Saturday, October 24, 2026
• Class 2:30–3:30 PM · check-in begins 2:15 PM
• Boston Modern Studio · 15 Marshall Street, Building J, Canton, MA 02021
• Gentle, all-levels yoga
• 15 spots to keep the room comfortable for people and puppies
• Ages 18+ only
• Wear something you don't mind a puppy paw on

GOOD TO KNOW
• Tickets are limited. When it's sold out, it's sold out.
• Tickets are non-refundable but fully transferable.
• Real puppies: expect a little chaos, a little noise and a lot of joy. The rescue's volunteers handle everything the puppies do.

About Kitten Paws and Downward Dogs
We are a 501(c)(3) that produces puppy events with adoptable animals from rescues and shelters only — never breeders. Across 100+ events we have raised $125K+ for animal rescues. kittenpawsdownwarddogs.org
